capabilities: Extract flashcards from notes using deterministic rules (Q/A lines, definitions, tables, cloze)
Review cards with typed-answer comparison, grades, and Anki-style SM-2 scheduling
Track retention and study metrics on a dashboard with CSV/JSON export
Import Anki .apkg, CSV/TSV, and JSON decks; export decks as JSON, CSV, Markdown, or Anki text
Create cards manually from selections, headings, or typed separator lines
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Automatic card generation is off by default on new installs; the plugin makes no network requests and stores review history in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note content into flashcards, schedule spaced-repetition reviews, or measure recall retention.

relations.evidence: Import: Anki .apkg (older collection format) incl. scheduling, history, media

summary: Spaced-repetition flashcard plugin that extracts cards from Markdown notes by rules, schedules reviews with an SM-2 variant, and tracks retention.
